howItWorks.title: How OxSteed Works
howItWorks.subtitle: OxSteed connects customers with local helpers. Whether you need work done or want to earn money in your community, we make it simple and easy to use.
howItWorks.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to what most people ask about OxSteed.
howItWorks.readySubtitle: Join your local OxSteed community today. It only takes a couple of minutes.
howItWorks.customerStep1Desc: Sign up in about 5 minutes. No credit card required.
howItWorks.customerStep2Desc: Describe what you need — handyman work, cleaning, yard work, moving help, and more. Set your budget and timeline.
howItWorks.customerStep3Desc: Qualified local helpers see your job and send competitive bids. Compare profiles, ratings, and pricing side by side.
howItWorks.customerStep4Desc: Choose the best fit, communicate through our messaging system, and get the job done. Leave a review when complete.
howItWorks.helperStep2Desc: See real jobs posted by customers in your area. Submit competitive bids and showcase your experience.
howItWorks.helperStep3Desc: Win jobs, complete the work, and build your reputation with reviews. Grow your local business on your schedule.
howItWorks.faq1A: Yes. Posting jobs as a customer is completely free. All users can sign up at no cost and bid on a limited number of jobs per month, or upgrade to a paid plan for expanded access.
howItWorks.faq2Q: How does OxSteed verify its users?
howItWorks.faq2A: Every user completes identity verification during registration. We may also run background checks and collect tax information (such as a W-9) when a user chooses to receive payment via OxSteed. Customer reviews further build each helper's reputation over time.
howItWorks.faq3Q: What types of jobs can I post?
howItWorks.faq3A: Handyman, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, moving, painting, landscaping, yard work, tool rental, general labor, and more. If it's a local service task, you can post it on OxSteed.
howItWorks.faq4Q: How do I communicate with a helper or customer?
howItWorks.faq4A: Once a bid is accepted, both parties can message each other securely through OxSteed's built-in messaging system without the need to share personal phone numbers.
howItWorks.faq5A: OxSteed is a marketplace that connects customers with independent business owners and does not control how individual jobs are performed or paid for. If there's an issue with a job, either party can open a case in our dispute resolution center, and our team will try to help mediate a fair outcome when possible.

upgrade.helperSubtitle: Get verified, unlock priority placement, and start earning more with Pro.
upgrade.customerSubtitle: Unlock budget tracking, goal setting, saved helpers, and the full life dashboard.
upgrade.forCustomersDesc: Complete ID verification to unlock protected payments. Your money is secure until the job is done.
upgrade.forHelpersDesc: Complete ID verification, background check, and set up your Stripe Express account to accept protected payments.
upgrade.cancelConfirm: Are you sure you want to cancel? You'll keep access until the end of your billing period.
upgrade.faq1A: Pro gives you a verified badge, the ability to submit bids on jobs, priority search placement, background check eligibility, identity verification, push notifications for urgent jobs, and the full Life Dashboard with budget tracking, goals, home maintenance reminders, and community insights.
upgrade.faq2A: Yes, you can cancel your Pro subscription at any time. You'll keep access to all Pro features until the end of your current billing period. No cancellation fees.
upgrade.faq3A: OxSteed Protection is our secure payment system powered by Stripe. When a customer and helper agree on a job, the payment is processed through Stripe Connect. OxSteed takes a 7.1% platform fee (minimum $5), and the helper receives the rest minus Stripe's standard processing fees. This isn't a subscription — it's a per-transaction fee that only applies when you use OxSteed Protection for a job.
upgrade.faq4Q: How much does the helper actually receive?
upgrade.faq4A: On a $200 job, OxSteed takes $14.20 (7.1%) and Stripe's processing fee is approximately $6.10 (2.9% + $0.30). The helper receives approximately $179.70. The helper is the merchant of record — payments go directly to their Stripe Express account.
upgrade.faq5Q: Do I need Pro to use OxSteed Protection?
upgrade.faq5A: OxSteed Protection is available to all verified users — both Free and Pro. However, Pro helpers have priority placement which means more job opportunities, and the verified badge builds more trust with customers.
upgrade.faq6Q: What's the difference between monthly and yearly?
upgrade.faq6A: Monthly is ${{monthly}}/month. Yearly is ${{yearly}}/year — that's ${{perMonth}}/month, saving you ${{savings}} per year ({{pct}}% off).
upgrade.faq7A: Absolutely. All payments are processed through Stripe, a PCI Level 1 certified payment processor. OxSteed never stores your credit card information.
upgrade.proF8: Full Life Dashboard — budgets, goals, tracking
upgrade.protectionDesc: When you use OxSteed Protection, payments are processed securely through Stripe. The customer pays the agreed job price, and OxSteed takes a simple 7.1% platform fee (minimum $5). That's it — one transparent fee that covers payment processing, dispute mediation, and platform support.
upgrade.protectionNote: * OxSteed Protection requires ID verification for customers and ID verification + background check + Stripe account for helpers.
